newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Flood in Ilan drowns 30,000 chickens, causing over T$2 million in damages.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Housing subsidies aim at low-income residents.
President Lee Teng-hui's National Day speech focuses on national security, economic prosperity.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Merged business tax proposal benefits small business owners.
Taiwan to work with World Bank on aid to South Africa.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan's Mosel Vitelic and Siemens to sign DRAM joint venture.
Third-quarter exports rose one percent, lowest growth in six years.
